description: The plot illustrates the average correct gate rate in relation to an unspecified variable on the x-axis, comparing different input types and models. The x-axis is labeled with numeric values ranging from 0 to 30, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate" and spans from 0.2 to 1.0, also with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays four lines representing different input types and models: Character Attention input (blue solid line), Character MLP input (blue dashed line), Wiki Attention input (red solid line), and Wiki MLP input (red dashed line). The Character Attention input line starts at approximately 0.2 at x=0, increases to around 0.8 at x=5, then decreases to about 0.3 at x=12 before rising to approximately 0.7 at x=30, with some fluctuations. The Character MLP input line begins at around 0.8 at x=0, decreases to about 0.5 at x=12, and then increases to approximately 0.9 at x=20, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The Wiki Attention input line starts at around 0.2 at x=0, rises to about 0.8 at x=5, drops to approximately 0.4 at x=12, and then fluctuates between 0.6 and 0.7 from x=15 to x=30. The Wiki MLP input line begins at around 0.8 at x=0, decreases to about 0.5 at x=12, and then increases to approximately 0.9 at x=18, remaining relatively stable thereafter. Each line is accompanied by a shaded region indicating the range of uncertainty or variation.
